label: Lincoln
header:
# Lincoln municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 13; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists Lincoln's five selectboard members as Lori Atkins, Joe Martell, Tim McGowan (Chair), Lisa Sargent, and Ken Stockman
Town of Lincoln (official website), Town Directory page: the Selectboard is Tim McGowan (Chair), Ken Stockman (Vice Chair), Lisa Sargent, Joe Martell, and Lori Atkins

Town of Lincoln, 2025 Town Report: 'Elected Officials' table seats the same board except Jessica Erwin in the two-year seat expiring March 2026; the current directory and the SOS directory seat Lori Atkins, who was elected to that seat in 2026
Town of Lincoln, Warning for the February 28, 2026 annual town meeting (officers elected by Australian ballot March 3, 2026): Article 1 elects a Town Clerk for a one-year term
Town of Lincoln, 2025 Town Report: 'Elected Officials' table: Sally Ober is Town Clerk
Town of Lincoln (official website), Town Directory page: Sally Ober is Town Clerk
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Sally Ober as Lincoln's town clerk

Town of Lincoln, 2025 Town Report: 'Appointed by the Selectboard' table: the Town Treasurer is Laurie Childers (Assistant Treasurer Patricia Waugh, who is the Town Administrator). The office does not appear on the ballot; the January 2026 Guide's Patricia Waugh entry is superseded
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town treasurer contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): lists Laurie Childers as Lincoln's town treasurer contact
Town of Lincoln, Warning for the February 28, 2026 annual town meeting (officers elected by Australian ballot March 3, 2026): Article 1 elects a Town Meeting Moderator
Town of Lincoln (official website), Town Directory page: Co'Relous Bryant is Town Meeting Moderator

Town of Lincoln, 2025 Town Report: 'Elected Officials' table: Co'Relous Bryant is Moderator, marked '(appointed to fill vacancy)' for the pre-2026 term; the 2026 warning warned the office for election and the current directory seats him
Town of Lincoln, Warning for the February 28, 2026 annual town meeting (officers elected by Australian ballot March 3, 2026): Article 1 elects a First Constable
Town of Lincoln, 2025 Town Report: 'Elected Officials' table: Matt Collins is First Constable
Town of Lincoln (official website), Town Directory page: Matt Collins is First Constable
Town of Lincoln, Warning for the February 28, 2026 annual town meeting (officers elected by Australian ballot March 3, 2026): Article 1 elects a Second Constable
Town of Lincoln, 2025 Town Report: 'Elected Officials' table: Erika French is Second Constable
Town of Lincoln (official website), Town Directory page: Erika French is Second Constable
Town of Lincoln, Warning for the February 28, 2026 annual town meeting (officers elected by Australian ballot March 3, 2026): Article 1 elects a Collector of Delinquent Taxes
Town of Lincoln, 2025 Town Report: 'Elected Officials' table: Nancy Stevens is Collector of Delinquent Taxes
Town of Lincoln (official website), Town Directory page: Nancy Stevens is Collector of Delinquent Taxes

Town of Lincoln, 2025 Town Report: 'Elected Officials' table lists five elected Lincoln Library Trustees (alongside four trustees appointed by the Library Board and one associate trustee, who are not modeled): Anna Smith (term to March 2028), Jacqueline Olson, Chair (2028), and Christine Dumond (2027) hold over; the two seats expiring March 2026 (Lonny Edwards's and Jenny Lawson Bates's) were warned for election in 2026 but no official source publishes the outcome, so they are left unfilled
Town of Lincoln, Warning for the February 28, 2026 annual town meeting (officers elected by Australian ballot March 3, 2026): Article 1 elects two Lincoln Library Trustees for three-year terms

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): names six justices of the peace for Lincoln and prints the seventh seat 'vacant': Mark Mulqueen, Nancy Stevens, Ari Kirshenbaum, Harrison Reynolds, Ilana Brett, and Sally Taylor
Town of Lincoln, 2025 Town Report: 'Elected Officials' table names the same six (as 'Harry Reynolds' for Harrison Reynolds; the certified listing form is recorded)

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): six winners were named -- Ilana Brett, Ari Kirshenbaum, Mark Mulqueen, Harrison Reynolds, Nancy Stevens, and Sally Taylor -- and the seventh seat is listed 'vacant'
